GenAiFunction.description: Routes a loan application to a senior credit analyst and returns the evidence behind that decision. Call this when grounding confidence is low, or a financial disparity is flagged, on the loan application being assessed. Returns the escalation reason plus a full evidence trail: the confidence band and exactly which evidence signals are missing, the declared and verified figures, the disparity, and the current bureau result. Present the reason and the evidence trail to the analyst. Never clear an escalation yourself — only a senior credit analyst can close one.
GenAiFunction.progressIndicatorMessage: Escalating to a senior credit analyst…
